                VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

        VALUES ($1, CAST($2 AS jsonb))

INSERT INTO anchors
                (id, kind, arch_type, arch_module, fingerprint, root_id,
                 src, dst, undirected, props, format_version, version, updated_at)
            VALUES
            (CAST($1 AS uuid), $2, $3, $4, $5, CAST($6 AS uuid), CAST($7 AS uuid), CAST($8 AS uuid), $9, CAST($10 AS jsonb), $11, $12, now())

                kind = EXCLUDED.kind,
                arch_type = EXCLUDED.arch_type,
                arch_module = EXCLUDED.arch_module,
                fingerprint = EXCLUDED.fingerprint,
                root_id = EXCLUDED.root_id,
                src = EXCLUDED.src,
                dst = EXCLUDED.dst,
                undirected = EXCLUDED.undirected,
                props = EXCLUDED.props,
                format_version = EXCLUDED.format_version,
                version = EXCLUDED.version + 1,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE anchors.version = EXCLUDED.version
            RETURNING id, version

DISCARD ALL

SELECT 1 FROM identity_lookups lk
        JOIN identity_users t ON lk.user_id = t.user_id
